questions.q: Which ribbon button do you select to start connecting to any data source in Power BI Desktop?
options: New visual
Get data
Transform data
Publish
questions.explain: Get data, on the Home ribbon, opens the list of every connector Power BI Desktop supports, regardless of the source type.

questions.q: In the Navigator window, what does selecting Load do (as opposed to Transform Data)?
options: Publishes the report to the Power BI service
Opens Power Query Editor to clean the data first
Deletes the connection
Brings the selected table(s) into the model as-is
questions.explain: Load brings the checked tables straight into your model. Transform Data instead opens Power Query Editor for cleaning first — Chapter 3's subject.

questions.q: You drag one numeric field onto the canvas, then drag a date field onto the same visual. What happens?
options: Power BI redraws the same visual to show the numbers broken out by date
Nothing — you must select a chart type first
Power BI creates a second, separate visual
Power BI shows an error because you added two fields
questions.explain: Dragging additional fields onto an existing visual updates it in place — Power BI redraws the chart using all the fields currently assigned to it.

questions.q: What file format does Power BI Desktop use to save your data, model, and report together?
options: .csv
.pbit
.xlsx
.pbix
questions.explain: A .pbix file is Power BI Desktop's native format, holding the data, the model, and the report in one file on your computer.

questions.q: Why doesn't this lesson cover publishing the report to the Power BI service?
options: It was covered already in Lesson 1
Publishing is its own step in the five-step workflow, covered properly in Chapter 9
Publishing requires a paid license that this course doesn't cover
Power BI Desktop can't publish reports
questions.explain: Get, Transform, Model, Visualize, and Publish are each their own step. This lesson only covers Get and a first pass at Visualize; Publish gets its own dedicated treatment in Chapter 9.
